1. **Test Suite Execution:** The full suite of tests was run to ensure comprehensive coverage of the patch's impact on our system.

3. **Investigation:** The development team is actively investigating the root causes of these failures. Preliminary analysis suggests that the issues are related to edge cases that were not fully addressed in the patch.
